nodes.name: IntroMovieModule
nodes.description: Plays the introductory movie, detects mouse click to skip, and transitions to the main menu.

nodes.name: MainMenuModule
nodes.description: Renders the main menu with help, team summary, website link, start button, and Denominators link.

nodes.name: QuestionQueryModule
nodes.description: Provides read‑only access to fraction questions for gameplay, supporting CQRS query side.

nodes.name: QuestionCommandModule
nodes.description: Handles administrative updates to fraction questions, implementing CQRS command side and persisting changes.

edges.justification: IntroMovieModule triggers a state transition to MainMenuModule upon user skip or movie completion.
MainMenuModule initiates the gameplay sequence by requesting the initial question set from QuestionQueryModule.
QuestionQueryModule supplies the current question data and hints to the Presentation layer for display and gameplay logic.
MainMenuModule (acting as the active gameplay view) forwards player fraction inputs to QuestionQueryModule for validation and processing.
QuestionQueryModule returns validation status, correctness feedback, and adaptive storyline branching data to the Presentation layer.
QuestionCommandModule notifies QuestionQueryModule of data changes to ensure the query module serves the latest question data without restart.
